Third-party libraries used by the monthly report export (loaded only when you click Download):

- pptxgen.bundle.js: PptxGenJS 3.12.0 (MIT) https://github.com/gitbrent/PptxGenJS
- html2canvas-pro.min.js: html2canvas-pro 1.5.8 (MIT) https://github.com/yorickshan/html2canvas-pro
- jspdf.umd.min.js: jsPDF 2.5.1 (MIT) https://github.com/parallax/jsPDF
